findings.summary: Bootstrap-only database secrets were removed from shared ECS execution-role access.
app_role received the existing runtime repositories' required mutation privileges.
Temporal bootstrap now reuses the module-owned password secret.
The RDS parameter-group family follows the configured PostgreSQL major version.
Production uses continuous cross-region automated-backup replication for the regional RPO.
app_role can perform the required llm_usage reservation reconciliation update.
Whole-instance recovery points and copies expire after the 35-day data-policy ceiling.
Rollback is write-freeze-only; post-write rollback requires reviewed reconciliation.
Disposable restore cleanup no longer creates an unbounded final snapshot.
Exercise cleanup cannot delete a promoted production restore target.
PITR, AWS Backup selection, and Osaka replication must protect a promoted ARN before writes resume.
DR verification selects the replicated automated backup by emitted ARN.
Backup and copy job checks filter on the selected RDS ARN and destination vault.
Runtime INSERT into schema_migrations is revoked and rejected by the measured PostgreSQL test.

final_review.summary: No discrete correctness, security, or compatibility defects were found in the reviewed commit.

final_commit_scope: Evidence-only amend after the reviewed code commit.
